row.proto: uint64_t Vm_NodeSet_Vec3_CheckedNotify(void *node, const float *value4, uint32_t source, char force)
row.notes: Returns 0 if node +0x26 bit0 is set. Reads the current value through the value holder at node+0x58 (vtbl+0x38); unless force!=0 it compares the first 3 float lanes (movmsk&7) and returns 1 when equal. Otherwise clears dirty (+0x60 bit1), clones the old value when the listener list +0x40..+0x48 is non-empty, stores via holder vtbl+0x40, repairs a non-finite float (restores old or writes 1.0f) when the holder type is the type at 0x14612bbe0, marks dirty and calls Ne_VmBinding_InvokeListeners with a change record (node+8, source, old, new). All callers first check the holder type against the desc at 0x14612be88 and then push a 16-byte vector: 0x1415660c0 builds lap_series/practice_programme graph nodes, 0x1417afa10 is a find-or-create child setter that passes force=1 on create, 0x14181b9f0 writes per-slot positions in a loop. Good hook for vec3 view-model writes. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
